meta.name: Midnight Mass
meta.description: The arrival of a charismatic young priest brings glorious miracles, ominous mysteries and renewed religious fervor to a dying town desperate to believe.

videos.title: Book I: Genesis
videos.overview: Riley Flynn returns home to family dysfunction, familiar faces and a new priest at St. Patrick's. Elsewhere on the island, a dark storm is brewing.

videos.title: Book II: Psalms
videos.overview: An unsettling omen washes ashore in the wake of the storm. Later, when the locals gather for a potluck, tragedy strikes — and a miracle occurs.

videos.title: Book III: Proverbs
videos.overview: Miraculous times leave residents stunned as Leeza pays Joe an important visit. A shocking confession reveals what really happened to Monsignor Pruitt.

videos.title: Book IV: Lamentations
videos.overview: Erin turns to Riley after receiving upsetting news. Father Paul starts experiencing disturbing side effects. Bev makes a startling discovery.

videos.title: Book V: Gospel
videos.overview: Sheriff Shabazz fields multiple missing persons reports as the town prepares to gather for Good Friday. To protect Erin, Riley brings the truth to light.

videos.title: Book VI: Acts of the Apostles
videos.overview: A fervent Bev calls for faith on the night of Easter vigil. Sarah reveals the results of a troubling experiment — along with a sobering hypothesis.

videos.title: Book VII: Revelation
videos.overview: Night falls on Crockett Island as a tight-knit group of rebels take refuge where they can and forge a plan to control the chaos.
